mechanical_engineer.name: Mechanical Engineer
mechanical_engineer.blurb: Owns the load paths, the thermal budget, and every argument about tolerances.

computer_scientist.name: Computer Scientist
computer_scientist.role: Burst damage and Technical Debt removal
computer_scientist.blurb: Can halve any problem in half the time, and will tell you the complexity class while doing it.

ee_engineer.name: Electrical & Electronics Engineer
ee_engineer.blurb: Knows where the return current actually goes. Nobody else does.

system_engineer.name: System Engineer
system_engineer.role: Force multiplier; lowers difficulty for everyone
system_engineer.blurb: Wins not by rolling well but by changing what everyone else rolls against.

product_manager.name: Product Manager
product_manager.role: Resource manipulation; trades debt for speed
product_manager.blurb: Can make any problem disappear. It comes back in the next phase, larger.

mechanical_technician.name: Mechanical Technician
mechanical_technician.blurb: Has fixed it before, has the fixture for it, and is not impressed by your CAD model.

electrical_technician.name: Electrical Technician
electrical_technician.blurb: Finds the fault in four minutes with a multimeter and an unkind expression.

control_systems_engineer.name: Control Systems Engineer
control_systems_engineer.blurb: Does not gamble. Estimates, then corrects.

mechatronics_engineer.name: Mechatronics Engineer
mechatronics_engineer.blurb: Fluent in three disciplines and trusted by none of them.
